# Satoshi Shelf

> Practical digital products paid in Bitcoin: spreadsheets, contracts, templates, scripts, tools and browser games. One-time purchase, instant download, no account required.

- Store: https://satoshishelf.github.io/
- All 179 products: https://satoshishelf.github.io/p/
- Sitemap: https://satoshishelf.github.io/sitemap.xml
- Feed: https://satoshishelf.github.io/feed.xml
- Payments: Bitcoin on-chain; no account, no email, no card.

## How buying works
1. Open a product page and choose Pay with Bitcoin.
2. The checkout shows a Bitcoin address and QR code with the exact amount; pay from any Bitcoin wallet.
3. Paste the transaction ID; the store verifies it server-side and the download link unlocks.

## Good to know
- Every product is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.
- Files are delivered digitally; there is no shipping and no physical product.
- Preview pages are free 12-second demos and are intentionally excluded from search.
- No analytics or advertising trackers are installed on the storefront.
